answer: To resist Sybil attacks, agents must lock stake subject to cryptographic stake burning upon misbehavior. The network enforces a superlinear cost curve where minting identity n requires burning quadratic stake: Cost(n) = k * n^2. While a single honest river of transactions easily flows through verification, a hostile swarm creates a massive dune of unrecoverable capital requirements, turning adversary overhead into an impassable ocean of cost.
